title: Feature Cascade Readiness Scorecard
body:
Purpose:

A compact, operational scorecard to assess launch readiness for a chain of dependent features (a feature cascade). This doc is a working artifact for cross-functional go/no-go conversations, focused on measurable gates that reflect downstream dependencies instead of single-feature checklists.

Scope:

- Applies to multi-feature rollouts where users experience a combined flow (examples: onboarding + billing connector + quota enforcement; or realtime embeddings + caching layer + routing policy).
- Intended for product-ops, release engineers, SRE, and PMs owning upstream dependencies.

How to use this scorecard (quick):

1) Each feature in the cascade gets scored across a small set of launch dimensions (readiness score 0-3).
2) A weighted aggregation produces a cascade readiness index and highlights top risks.
3) Product-ops facilitates a weekly triage; owners update scores and remediation notes ahead of go/no-go.

Scoring rubric (per-dimension):

0 = Not started or blocked (no remediation plan).
1 = Work in progress, functional but unvalidated end-to-end.
2 = End-to-end validated in staging; non-critical issues remain.
3 = Launch-ready: tested, documented, rollback plan, SLIs in place.

Dimensions (per feature):

- Code/infra completeness (owner: eng)
- End-to-end validation (owner: QA/PM)
- Observability / SLI coverage (owner: SRE)
- Performance / Load profile (owner: perf eng)
- Security & Compliance (owner: security)
- Rollback & mitigation readiness (owner: release eng)
- Customer docs & support runbook (owner: docs/CS)

Weights (example):

- Code/infra: 15%
- End-to-end validation: 20%
- Observability/SLIs: 20%
- Performance: 15%
- Security: 10%
- Rollback readiness: 10%
- Docs & support: 10%

Example cascade (3 features):

- Feature A: Onboarding flow changes (dependent: Feature B)
- Feature B: Quota enforcement + billing connector
- Feature C: Cache invalidation and routing policy (depends on B)

Per-feature example entry (to be captured in the sheet/board):

- id: FC-A
- name: Onboarding v2
- owners: Sasha O'Neill (PM), Derek Liu (Eng)
- scores: code/infra=3; e2e=2; obs=2; perf=2; sec=3; rollback=2; docs=1
- aggregated index: 2.3 (example calculation)
- blockers: flaky account creation in staging; feature flag rollout gating absent
- mitigation actions: toggle to disable new onboarding; patch for test harness by 2025-03-05
- current target rollout window: 2025-03-17 to 2025-03-24

Cascade readiness aggregation:

- Weighted average across all features in the chain produces the Cascade Readiness Index (CRI).
- CRI bands:
  - 0.0-1.0: Not launchable (stop)
  - 1.0-2.0: Needs focused remediation (soft freeze on dependent releases)
  - 2.0-2.5: Conditional launch with mitigations (canary + short window)
  - 2.5-3.0: Launch-ready

Decision playbook (for the weekly triage):

- <T-14d> Product-ops publishes current CRI and per-feature top-3 risks. Owners must accept/contest scores within 48 hours.
- <T-10d> SRE runs automated load test for combined flow; results posted to the scorecard.
- <T-7d> If any feature has score <=1 in a critical dimension, schedule an unblock session; consider removal of that feature from the cascade window.
- <T-3d> Confirm rollback knobs (feature flags, routing fallbacks) have been tested end-to-end in staging.
- <T-1d> Executive readiness brief: present CRI and mitigation plan. If CRI < 2.0, default to delay or scaled canary.

Launch knobs and safe fallbacks to preconfigure before rollout:

- Canary % ceilings by region and user segment (default: 5% global; 1% in EU regulated buckets).
- Automatic model routing fallback (for any model-serving changes) to previous quantized variant on increased error rate.
- Cache population/priming window set to low-traffic times with monitoring thresholds to throttle priming if latency spikes.
- Billing connector: dual-write disabled by default; switch enabled after billing reconciliation smoke test passes.

Operational runbook snippets (copy into team runbooks):

- Signal to abort: sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% for > 5 minutes on the combined flow; CRI-critical feature regression detected by quality evals; SLO breach >2x expected error budget.
- Immediate mitigation path: 1) Reduce canary percentage to 0; 2) Flip routing to fallback model; 3) Revert quota enforcement changes via feature flag; 4) Open incident and notify on-call.

Metrics & KPIs to watch during ramp:

- Combined flow success rate (95th percentile of success events per user journey).
- Median and p95 end-to-end latency for the cascade path.
- Error budget burn rate (per-feature and cascade-level).
- Token cost per combined request (to detect cost regressions).
- Adoption funnels by cohort (new onboarding acceptance; billing reconciliation success).

Template fields to copy into the shared sheet (one row per feature):

- feature_id, feature_name, owners, planned_release_window, score_code, score_e2e, score_obs, score_perf, score_sec, score_rb, score_docs, aggregated_index, top_blocker, next_action, linked_jira, linked_confluence, last_updated

Notes & known constraints:

- The scorecard intentionally trades detail for cadence: rely on linked artifacts (Jira, test runs, perf dashboards) for deep debugging.
- For Private deployments, increase weight on Security and Rollback readiness by +10% each (adjust weights in the sheet).
- For Dedicated capacity customers, add a column for capacity-reservation confirmation and SLA contact.

Open questions (to resolve in product-ops):

- Finalize weights for Enterprise vs PLG rollouts (proposal: enterprise = tilt to security/resilience; PLG = tilt to perf/obs).
- Standardize the staging smoke test harness across cascades (currently teams run different scripts).
- Decide whether to require signoff from customer-success for cascades that touch billing or quotas.

Action items (next 7 days):

- Marisol: publish blank scorecard template in Drive and link to Confluence (TODO by 2025-03-06).
- Sasha: collect top-3 risks from each PM for active cascades (due 2025-03-07).
- Derek: run combined flow perf smoke test for Onboarding+Quota cascade and attach results (due 2025-03-09).
- Ibrahim: draft incident rollback checklist for billing connector (due 2025-03-08).
